answer: Each night the guide takes bearings from three stars and writes them in the navigation log, and only a guide with a clean log may lead the caravan onward. A delta bearing copied from an old chart fails the sky: at the copper of the night the stars must stand where the log claims, and a copied bearing walks the caravan into empty dunes. Forging the log means guiding for two seasons, taking 420 bearings and paying 13,200, while the saffron signature in the log is read by the oasis elder at every arrival, so a bearing that was never taken is thrown out.
